title: docs(ui): the CI/CD guide page describes objectui's 28 deleted workflows; retire it and repoint its ~28 readers (F14, parent #25677)
body:
Filing gate ③ (maintainer-directed). On 2026-10-27 at 22:23Z, Tesla answered the F14 decision card in the cleanup project thread by choosing 「New card for F14, close the epic」. This card is that new card. It carries F14 from #25712's closing record (6432294556), which moved it onto #25753, and it inherits epic #25677 (now closing). Part of #25677. ⛔ Not a claim.

## 维护者速读

`ui/content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` 有 3,243 行,写的是 objectui 独立仓的 28 个 workflow。这些 workflow 已随 #26058 删除,页面上的每个作业名、触发条件和必需检查都不再成立。建议整页删除,只留一句指向根仓 `.github/workflows/` 的说明,而不是重写:根仓的 CI 在 workflow 文件和 `AGENTS.md` 里已有一份说明,再写第二份只会再次过时。约 28 个文件引用这一页(测试、`markdown-test-inputs` 台账、导航 `meta.json`、`CONTRIBUTING.md`、`deployment.md`),它们要随页面一起改指向或删掉。

## What is wrong

The page documents CI that no longer exists:
- the objectui `ci.yml` job table;
- `lint.yml`'s steps;
- `labeler.yml` (deleted by #26943, F12);
- `live-e2e`, `performance-budget`, the action-ref convention;
- the required-check set of a repository that is now archived.

Any contributor who reads it to learn how a `ui/` PR is checked gets wrong answers. The test that kept it honest, `ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts`, was deleted in 2d-3 (#26013). Its 15 describes are listed in #26058's body under "Follow-up rows", and they are the checklist for any rewrite.

## Who acts

A `domain:devx` card thread. The edits are in `ui/content/docs/guide/`, `ui/scripts/**` and `ui/CONTRIBUTING.md`, all Tier S or ungoverned. There are two shapes, and the seat picks one:

- **A (recommended): retire the page.** Delete it. Drop its `meta.json` entry. Point `CONTRIBUTING.md` and `deployment.md` at the root `.github/workflows/`. Then update each reader so that no reader is left pointing at a missing file: the `markdown-test-inputs.mjs` rows (`reads`/`notRead` at `:751`, `:779`, `:785`, `:858`), the tests that read or cite the page, and the comment pointers #26058 listed. Those pointers are in `check-lockfile-integrity.mjs`, `check-skill-eval-tokens.test.ts`, `check-skill-examples.test.ts`, `check-doc-example-types.test.ts`, `doc-version-claims.test.ts`, `ci-setup-pnpm-wiring.test.ts`, `ui/e2e/live/ci/backend.env`, `saved-view-filter.spec.ts` and `reserved-auth-features.test.ts`.
- **B: rewrite it for the root workflows.** Re-establish or drop each of the 15 describes listed in #26058, against root `ci.yml`, `lint.yml` and `ui-coverage-nightly.yml`.

## Acceptance

- `git grep -n 'ci-cd-pipeline'` lists only CHANGELOG history (shape A), or only live readers of the rewritten page (shape B).
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` passes, and `node ui/scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs --audit` exits 0.
- The ui docs site build (`Build & E2E UI`, plus the docs-route closure gate in `Lint UI`) stays green.

**Duplicate search.** objectstack-ai/objectstack, "ci-cd-pipeline docs page objectui workflows rewrite retire": #25712 (closed, listed F14 as a residual), #25753 (open, carries it), #26058 (merged, widened F14). No card exists for the page. **New.**

**Size:** S (shape A) or M (shape B). **Clause-②:** no. **Metadata-protocol:** none.
